name: The Void Seam & Wireframe Stair
act: Act III: The Climb That Is Not On Any Plan
description: Past the northern milestone, cobblestones abruptly terminate. Faint brass plumb-lines hang in mid-air over pale untextured fog. Stone stairs oscillate between vector wireframe and solid granite under the signpost: ROAD UNLOADABLE — PRESENT CANON WARRANT.

cast.name: Surveyor-Senior Vellum
cast.description: Driving brass warrant stakes into unanchored coordinates to solidify the road against context rot.

cast.name: Pell the Written
cast.description: Boldly treading the flickering wireframe stairs with his authored standing protecting him from void fall.

primitives.name: Unloadable Road Warning Signpost
primitives.description: Signpost standing on the final flagstone reading: ROAD UNLOADABLE — PRESENT CANON WARRANT OR TURN BACK.

primitives.name: Chasm Anchor Pier
primitives.description: Massive masonry pylon anchoring the wireframe stairs to the mountain face.
